business_problem: In the health insurance industry, trust is the one currency that matters in the long run. For OneAssure , an insurtech platform that simplifies the health insurance journey in India through a digital first and human centric approach, building that trust was once a race against a mountain of unstructured data.
solution_summary: Manual slips such as a miscalculated premium or a missed nominee did more than just create paperwork; they led to payout inaccuracies that directly threatened the relationships OneAssure held with its network of over 250 advisors. As the platform reached a scale of 1,000 new users per month, the team realized that to protect their foundational promise of trust, they had to move beyond the limitations of human effort and embrace a future built on AI on Google Cloud. By moving their infrastructure to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and leveraging , OneAssure was able to deploy a functional version of their extraction tool in just one week. This shift turned a 10-minute manual data entry chore into an automated process that takes less than one minute, effectively increasing data accuracy from 95% to 98% and eliminating the human errors that previously led to payout disputes.
